notes.title: Mipumi Games reveals turn-based tactical folktale Howl
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! 👋

We are Mipumi, an indie development studio based in Austria, creators of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/437160/The_Lions_Song_Episode_1__Silence/]The Lion’s Song[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034750/The_Flower_Collectors/]The Flower Collectors[/url], and this is our new game [url=https://howl-game.com/]Howl[/url]. 🏹 🐺

Welcome! Thanks for stopping by.

[previewyoutube=v-DgJWRByBw;full][/previewyoutube]

Howl is a game of planning and prophecy inspired by mediaeval folktales. The land has fallen to the mysterious ‘howling plague’, which turns all to hear it into beasts. You play a deaf hero travelling in search of a cure. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/0c62f8832edf35f0ab77188644259149dca3d873.png[/img]

Combat in [b]Howl[/b] is tactical and turn-based: plan your battles up to six steps in advance, outflanking your monstrous enemies. As you fight you’ll weave a continuous piece of scripture, creating the prophecy of your own life. The world of [b]Howl[/b] is rendered in a unique [i]‘living ink’[/i] style that paints the story as you play, evoking the tapestries and manuscripts that inspired this world. 📜

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/325322aca137f0c68c557a1ce0a34836494cfbdd.gif[/img]

That’s all we can tell you for now, but rest assured we have plenty more cool details to reveal. Please be sure to follow and wishlist if you like the look of the game!

Best,
Team Mipumi

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/3436b71a5406fddda3380f6cbdab6a42fdf48c5a.png[/img]

notes.title: LudoNarraCon - The Flower Collectors Making of
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to LudoNarraCon![/h1]

Thanks for joining us on this Behind-the-scenes special LudoNarraCon stream to learn more about the making of The Flower Collectors!

Stay tuned for insights about the art & character design, the decisions that drove the aesthetics & art style as well as the historic background of the post-Franco era in Spain in the 70s.

[list]
[*]Dive into the world of detectives and murder mysteries in a Let's Play of the first 3 chapters with producer Eline, and see how two very diverse characters are thrown together in a common destiny
[*]Listen to Tobe, lead designer, as he shares insights about character design, story background and gameplay features
[*]Learn from senior artist David as he shows you our development tools and see how the art evolved from first concepts to the final game
[/list]

How does the story unfold? Who are the protagonists aka suspects in this detective mystery set in the political powder-keg of Barcelona in 1977?

Enjoy the first glimpse of The Flower Collectors.

We are excited to share this behind-the-scenes look with you and would love to hear what you think! Leave a comment below this post or follow us [url=https://www.twitter.com/mipumi]on Twitter[/url]!

Your Mipumi Team

notes.title: The Flower Collectors is out now!
notes.notes:
Dear players, friends and fans,

We’ve been looking forward to saying this for a long time, we are so happy and proud to tell you that The Flower Collectors launches TODAY! You can find a little teaser below and the [url=https://youtu.be/TkrcocuM8H4]full launch trailer here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/44d016db273d4296a4149f0272c8276c9722bd11.gif[/img]

We sincerely hope you will enjoy Jorge’s and Melinda’s adventure as much as we enjoyed making the game! 

The whole team is super excited to hear what you think, watch let’s plays and finally be able to share our version of a colorful Barcelona with you. 

As you probably know, we’re a small indie studio making games that aren’t exactly mainstream, so every Steam user review we can get makes a big difference for us. If you enjoy our work and would like to see more of it this is the best way you can support us (aside from buying the game, of course)!

From Vienna with love,

The Mi’pu’mi Team

notes.title: The Flower Collectors is launching on 21st April!
notes.notes:
Dear players, friends and fans,

We’ve got some truly exciting news to share: The Flower Collectors has an official release date! 

Jorge’s and Melinda’s adventure will start on the [b]21st April[/b] on PC and we truly can't wait for you to play the game! Here is a teaser trailer we made for the occasion:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uJnw7eoQa90

[h2]Meet new suspects![/h2]
In the latest update you got a sneak peak at the protagonists of the game. Like every good murder mystery, The Flower Collectors features both detectives and suspects. Today, we’re introducing you to a small part of the cast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/190ac90b9294480170f86bae21c11cc5ee197c4b.png[/img]
[i]“The mechanics, Marietta and Luisa. Always busy... Anna said the lights in their workshop were on during the night of the murder.” [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/a8adaf97d1b4f82d095fffa513c29c7f481a4b88.jpg[/img]
[i]“Lola, the cabaret singer, has been frequenting the café across the plaza a lot lately. Why would she suddenly become such a loyal customer?” [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/ae984131eefba495343d336c8c5ec75a45860bc3.png[/img]
[i]“Padre Eusebio is the head of the local church. All those confessions... he must have dirt on practically everyone around here.”[/i]

[h2]A little glimpse of gameplay[/h2]
While we have previously shown you a few set pieces of our Barcelona 1977 setting, and now also introduced some of the suspects that inhibit the colourful city, today we also want to give you a first look teaser of how the gameplay of The Flower Collectors will look like.

While we don’t want to give away too much just now, we can say that the game will be played in a first-person perspective. You can even see Jorge's shadow & wheelchair when you look down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/ae2f9610b4462877a2e7c184647bab40b91f6cd3.gif[/img]

From Jorge’s balcony you will be able to watch as day-to-day life plays out in the neighbourhood below, to piece together clues. One very handy tool for that will be a camera, which you’ll be able to use to take pictures as evidence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/5303a82c5ed2230bd4e76eaec40bde34f2ee3259.gif[/img]

Lastly, you will be able to pin pictures up on your evidence board to try to work out who the murderer might be. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/e1dac39af68d453d628663548ebfd015eaf2ce9f.gif[/img]

That’s it for today! We’ll be sharing more updates soon, and if you want to you can wishlist the game (which helps us a lot) or follow us on [url=https://www.twitter.com/mipumi]twitter[/url] for even more regular updates. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034750/The_Flower_Collectors/

From Vienna with love,

The Mi’pu’mi Team

notes.title: Meet the protagonists of The Flower Collectors! 🐻😼
notes.notes:
Dear players, friends and fans,

Thanks a lot for the great support and feedback we got from announcing The Flower Collectors! 

Since then we’ve been busy working on the game, but of course also wanted to give you an update on the world of The Flower Collectors. 

Today we are finally ready to show you the protagonists of our detective adventure!

[h2]Meet Jorge & Melinda[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/8fa8ed51713ab65e326baee8a263185553f82009.png[/img]

In The Flower Collectors, you play as Jorge. 🐻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/c8d03067eb7cb6c171493544f8355aaf72315c9a.jpg[/img]

Jorge is an ex-cop, in a wheelchair, struggling with his new life. From his balcony, Jorge watches the world go by. Above you can see his apartment which plays a big role in the game. 

When he witnesses a murder, he unwillingly becomes part of the mystery himself…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/19008f53ef4a303f21814b064f695acca5de9ff4.png[/img]

The second protagonist: Melinda 😼
An ambitious journalist, determined to uncover the truth.

We will reveal more characters from the game over the next weeks!


[h2]Great media feedback[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/bfb2c5d04d45189a2c461f3a4b1d04886a875617.jpg[/img]

Apart from your social media support we also got a great reply from media with articles from all over the world like [url=https://www.gamespew.com/2020/03/unique-detective-game-the-flower-collectors-is-announced/]Gamespew[/url] and Adventure Gamer (English), [url=http://www.jeuxvideo.com/news/1190188/the-flower-collectors-du-studio-mi-pu-mi-the-lion-s-song-donne-de-ses-nouvelles.htm]Jeuxvideo[/url] in France, [url=https://www.4players.de/4players.php/spielinfonews/PC-CDROM/41603/2188480/The_Flower_Collectors-Tierisches_Detektiv-Adventure_der_Macher_von_The_Lions_Song.html]4Players[/url] in Germany, [url=https://www.eurogamer.it/articles/2020-03-05-news-videogiochi-the-flower-collectors-misterioso-thriller-trailer-creatori-the-lions-song]Eurogamer[/url] in Italy, [url=https://www.igromania.ru/news/91406/Avtory_priklyucheniya_The_Lions_Song_anonsirovali_detektiv_The_Flower_Collectors.html]Igromania[/url] in Russia and many more.

If you are a German speaker you can also [url=https://www.adventurecorner.de/news/7835/interview-zu-the-flower-collectors] watch an interview[/url] with Mipumi CEO Gregor on Adventurecorner.

[h2]Mipumi Games is 11 years old![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/ad66bd913e33f6aff3ba557a1a21f5f4599b67c3.jpg[/img]

In other news, we had our 11 year anniversary last month, time flies! Many thanks for your ongoing support!

The Flower Collectors will be coming to Steam this year. We can’t wait to show you more. If you want to you can [url=https://twitter.com/mipumi]follow us on Twitter[/url] for even more regular updates. 


From Vienna with love,

The Mi’pu’mi Team
